verses.1: Happy are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the Law of the LORD.
verses.2: Happy are those who keep his testimonies, who seek him with all their hearts.
verses.3: They do no wrong; they walk in his ways.
verses.4: You have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.
verses.5: My heart rejoices in your statutes; I will not forget your word.
verses.6: I will not be put to shame, for I have watched all your commandments.
verses.7: I will thank you with an upright heart, as I learn your righteous laws.
verses.8: I will keep your statutes; do not abandon me completely.
verses.9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping your word.
verses.10: With all my heart I have sought you; do not let me stray from your commandments.
verses.11: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.12: You are blessed, O LORD, teach me your statutes.
verses.13: I have spoken of all your decrees with my mouth.
verses.14: I have rejoiced in your law as much as in all riches.
verses.15: I will meditate on your commandments and reflect on your ways.
verses.16: I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget your word.
verses.17: Be gracious to your servant, that I may live and keep your word.
verses.18: Open my eyes, that I may behold the wonders of your law.
verses.19: I am a foreigner on earth; do not hide your commandments from me.
verses.20: My soul longs for your statutes at all times.
verses.21: You have rebuked the arrogant; those who stray from your commandments are accursed.
verses.22: Remove from me disgrace and contempt, for I have kept your testimonies.
verses.23: Even princes sit together against me, but your servant meditates on your statutes.
verses.24: Your testimonies are my delight; they are my counselors.
verses.25: My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word.
verses.26: I have told of my ways, and you have answered me; teach me your statutes.
verses.27: Make me understand the way of your commandments, and I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.28: My soul melts away from sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
verses.29: Remove the way of falsehood from me, and grant me your law in grace.
verses.30: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set your judgments before me.
verses.31: I have clung to your testimonies, O LORD; do not let me be put to shame.
verses.32: I will run in the way of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
verses.33: Teach me your way, O LORD, that I may keep your statutes diligently.
verses.34: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law; indeed, I will observe it with all my heart.
verses.35: Guide me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.
verses.36: Incline my heart to your testimonies, not to unjust gain.
verses.37: Turn my eyes from looking at vanity; give me life in your ways.
verses.38: Confirm your word to your servant, which you have promised to those who fear you.
verses.39: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.
verses.40: How I long for your commandments! In your righteousness give me life.
verses.41: Let your steadfast love come to me, O LORD, your salvation according to your promise.
verses.42: Then I will answer those who taunt me, for I trust in your word.
verses.43: Do not take the word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your judgments.
verses.44: I will keep your law continually, for ever and ever.
verses.45: I will walk in a wide place, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.46: I will speak of your testimonies before kings and will not be put to shame.
verses.47: I will delight in your commandments, which I have loved.
verses.48: I will lift up my hands to your commandments, which I have loved, and meditate on your statutes.
verses.49: Remember your word to your servant, for which you have given me hope.
verses.50: This is my comfort in my trouble, that your word gives me life.
verses.51: The arrogant have utterly derided me, yet I have not turned from your law.
verses.52: When I remember your judgments from of old, I take comfort, O LORD.
verses.53: Zeal for your statutes has made me tremble; they are my delight.
verses.54: Your decrees are my songs in the house of my sojourning.
verses.55: I remember your name in the night, O LORD, and keep your law.
verses.56: This is my reward, for I have kept your precepts.
verses.57: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your statutes.
verses.58: My soul is longing for your salvation; be gracious to me according to your word.
verses.59: I considered my ways and turned my feet to your statutes.
verses.60: I hastened and did not delay to keep your commandments.
verses.61: The wicked have snared me, but I have not forgotten your law.
verses.62: At midnight I rise to give thanks to you, for your just dealings.
verses.63: I am a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.
verses.64: Your steadfast love, O LORD, fills the earth; teach me your statutes.
verses.65: You have done well to me, O LORD, according to your word.
verses.66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.67: Before I was humbled, I went astray, but now I keep your word.
verses.68: You are good and do good; teach me your statutes.
verses.69: Falsehood clings to the wicked, but I keep your commandments with all my heart.
verses.70: Their hearts are as calloused as curdled milk, but I delight in your law.
verses.71: It is good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn your statutes.
verses.72: The law from your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
verses.73: Your hands have made me and shaped me; give me understanding, and I will learn your commandments.
verses.74: Those who fear you will see me and rejoice, for I have put my hope in your word.
verses.75: I know, O LORD, that your judgments are right and that you have afflicted me in faithfulness.
verses.76: Let your steadfast love comfort me according to your promise to your servant.
verses.77: Let your mercy come to me, that I may live, for your law is my delight.
verses.78: Let the arrogant be put to shame, for they have wronged me with lies. But I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.79: Let those who fear you turn to me, and those who know your testimonies.
verses.80: Let my heart be steadfast in your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
verses.81: My soul faints for your salvation; I put my hope in your word.
verses.82: My eyes fail, longing for your promise. When will you comfort me?
verses.83: For I have become like a wineskin in the summer, yet I have not forgotten your statutes.
verses.84: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.85: The wicked have dug pitfalls for me, but I do not stray from your law.
verses.86: All your commandments are trustworthy; the false ones have hunted me, but help me!
verses.87: Though I am small and despised, I do not forget your commandments.
verses.88: Give me life in your steadfast love, and I will keep your testimonies.
verses.89: O LORD, your word is forever settled in the heavens.
verses.90: Your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands firm.
verses.91: By your judgments the present order stands, for all things are your servants.
verses.92: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.93: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
verses.94: I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.95: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will consider your testimonies.
verses.96: I have seen the limit of all perfection; your commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.97: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day long.
verses.98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are ever with me.
verses.99: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.100: I understand more than the elders, for I keep your precepts.
verses.101: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might keep your word.
verses.102: I have not turned aside from your judgments, for you have taught me.
verses.103: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.104: From your precepts I gain understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
verses.105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
verses.106: I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to keep your righteous laws.
verses.107: I am deeply afflicted; give me life, according to your word.
verses.108: Accept, O LORD, the willing offerings of my mouth, and teach me your judgments.
verses.109: My soul is always in my hand, yet I do not forget your law.
verses.110: The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from your commandments.
verses.111: Your testimonies I have taken as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.112: I have inclined my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the very end.
verses.113: I hate double-mindedness, but I love your law.
verses.114: You are my refuge and my shield; your word is my hope.
verses.115: Turn away from me, you wicked, and I will keep your commandments.
verses.116: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let me be put to shame.
verses.117: Strengthen me, and I will be delivered; I will observe your statutes continually.
verses.118: You have rejected all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.119: You have made me jealous with what is not a god; but I delight in your law.
verses.120: My flesh trembles from fear of you, and I fear your judgments.
verses.121: I have done what is right and just; do not leave me to be oppressed.
verses.122: Be my surety, O LORD, for the good; let no wicked person oppress me.
verses.123: My eyes fail from looking for your salvation, for the promise of your righteousness.
verses.124: Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
verses.125: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
verses.126: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken your law.
verses.127: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than fine gold.
verses.128: Therefore I consider all your commandments to be right; I hate every false way.
verses.129: Your testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.130: The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.
verses.131: I open my mouth and pant, for I long for your commandments.
verses.132: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your custom toward those who love your name.
verses.133: Steady my steps according to your word; let no iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.134: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may keep your precepts.
verses.135: Make your face shine upon your servant, and teach me your statutes.
verses.136: My eyes run down with tears, because people do not keep your law.
verses.137: Righteous are you, O LORD, and your judgments are right.
verses.138: You have commanded your precepts in righteousness and great faithfulness.
verses.139: My zeal has worn me out, because my enemies forget your words.
verses.140: Your word is exceedingly pure; therefore your servant loves it.
verses.141: I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your commandments.
verses.142: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is truth.
verses.143: Trouble and anguish have found me out, but your commandments are my delight.
verses.144: Your testimonies are righteous forever; give me understanding, and I will live.
verses.145: I call with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD. I will keep your statutes.
verses.146: I call to you; save me, that I may keep your testimonies.
verses.147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your words.
verses.148: My eyes are awake before the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your word.
verses.149: Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; give me life, according to your justice.
verses.150: Those who seek mischief come near; they are far from your law.
verses.151: You are near, O LORD, and all your commandments are true.
verses.152: From of old I have known, from your testimonies, that you have established them forever.
verses.153: Look on my affliction and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.
verses.154: Defend my cause and redeem me; give me life according to your promise.
verses.155: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your statutes.
verses.156: Your steadfast love is great, O LORD; give me life according to your justice.
verses.157: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, but I do not turn from your testimonies.
verses.158: I saw the treacherous and loathed them, for they do not keep your word.
verses.159: Consider how I love your precepts! Give me life in your steadfast love.
verses.160: The sum of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous judgments endures forever.
verses.161: Rulers have persecuted me without cause, but my heart fears your word.
verses.162: I rejoice at your word like one who finds great spoil.
verses.163: I hate falsehood, but I love your law.
verses.164: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous judgments.
verses.165: Great peace have those who love your law; nothing can make them stumble.
verses.166: I hope for your salvation, O LORD, and I do your commandments.
verses.167: My soul keeps your testimonies; I love them exceedingly.
verses.168: I keep your commandments and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
verses.169: Let my cry come before you, O LORD; give me understanding according to your word.
verses.170: Let my plea come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
verses.171: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
verses.172: Let my tongue speak your word, for all your commandments are right.
verses.173: Let your hand be with me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.174: I long for your salvation, O LORD, and your law is my delight.
verses.175: Let my soul live, and it will praise you, and let your judgments help me.
verses.176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.

notes:
Notes
- v. 9: The phrase "How can a young man keep his way pure?" is rendered directly and clearly, with "pure" representing the concept of moral and spiritual integrity.
- v. 105: "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path" is a well-known metaphor, translated to retain its clarity and poetic imagery.
- v. 176: "I have gone astray like a lost sheep" reflects the metaphor from the Hebrew text, keeping it natural and accessible in English.
